pages.text:
An engine-generator set: it burns liquid and gas fuels straight to FE, a mid-game step below the Gas Turbine Array.
# Building
A solid box of Diesel Generator Casings 3 wide, 5 long and 2 tall, with the Diesel Generator Controller in the middle of the bottom of one end, facing out. Formed, it becomes the set: radiator and fan, an inline six with its stack, the flywheel housing and the alternator.

# Running
It runs up to speed over 3 seconds, then makes 3,000 FE/t. When its FE buffer fills it throttles back to what's drawn, burning only the fuel for that.
| Fuel | FE/mB | mB/t at full power |
| Diesel | 420 | 7.1 |
| Gasoline | 400 | 7.5 |
| Biodiesel | 340 | 8.8 |
| Refinery Gas | 240 | 12.5 |
# Ports
- Input: fuel in (liquid or gas).
- Energy: FE out, pushed to what it touches (8,192 FE/t a port).
The fuels are data-driven (arcforge:engine_fuels).
